children: United States Commodity Index Funds Trust disclosed that, on Sep 25 2026, The Marygold Companies entered a definitive all-cash agreement with Madison Dearborn Partners to take TMC private. TMC owns USCF Investments, the parent of United States Commodity Funds, sponsor of the Trust. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to stockholder, regulatory, and change-of-control approvals. After closing, TMC and Madison Dearborn plan to execute a strategy to refocus USCF’s business, though there is no assurance the deal will be completed.
: Advance transformation strategy and refocus USCF's business
